- Net income attributable to Chevron was $5,501 million.
- Total revenues and other income were $48,716 million.
- Net margin is 5,501 ÷ 48,716 = about 11.29%.

I used revenue including other income and net income attributable to Chevron. Using sales and other operating revenues alone ($46,580 million) would give about 11.8%.
